text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I stopped by a cafe,
I spotted Mejiro Ryan and Ines Fujin
acting rather suspiciously secretive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Awawa... I wonder if McQueen is going to be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, nano!
Be more aggressive, nano!

text_block_list.name: Ryan & Ines
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sh-Shh!
Come over here for a sec...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pulled along by Mejiro Ryan, I ended up hiding in the shadows with her. Ahead of where they were looking was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This fruit!
It is truly so juicy and fresh!
I am quite astonished!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it exceeded my expectations.
We have McQueen-san's thorough research to thank for that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it is not such a grand thing at all!
Today is simply my way of thanking you for helping me study...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen invited Ikuno-chan to hang out today as a way of saying thanks for everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"She was super pumped, saying,
"Let's go eat delicious desserts together
at the Seasonal Fruit Sweets Festival!""

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen seemed so nervous, though...!
I was so worried, I just couldn't sit still...!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can't just leave Mac-chan alone
when she's looking like that~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I happened to see them during my shift,
and I was wondering if there's any way we could help!?
choice_data_list: Looks like you're enjoying your meal, though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, look closely!
Her face is twitching just a bit.
So McQueen must be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(I dragged us to this Sweets Fest
just based on my own tastes, but
I wonder if Ikuno-san is having fun?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Should I have taken her to one of her favorite
horseshoe shops instead...?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (And after all the trouble I went to as a thank-you todayyy!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —is undoubtedly what they must be thinking!
choice_data_list: As expected of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to give McQueen-chan
a little push of encouragement!
Isn't there anything we can do!?
choice_data_list: Let's make the most of my position as a part-timer!
Let's help with the Mejiro bond!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see, that means it's my turn to shine!
Alright! I'll go talk to the manager so we can treat the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines, use these disguise goods!
Sunglasses, a wig, and a mask...
With these, you should be able to serve customers without being recognized!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, you know.
Here is your "Giant Parfait for Two,"
you know.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh? I don't believe I ordered anything like that...?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Clerk
text_block_list.text:
This is a complimentary item
from the Fruit Festival.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Clerk
text_block_list.text:
It's quite a large serving, so the two of you
must work together and feed each other 'say ahh'
until it's completely finished!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, an "aahhhn" feeding?!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪
Well then, I shall take my leave nano.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aaah... Saying 'open wide' like that...!?
Saying 'open wide' like that...!?
Ah, aaah... 'Open wide'...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Open wide~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Ah, aaah, aahh-ah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Mmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Does it taste good?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um...!
Not just my mouth, but... well...
Deep down in my heart, I am filled with sweetness...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My. You took quite a liking to
the sweets, didn't you? That's wonderful to hear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps there was no need to worry in the first place,
as Ikuno Dictus seemed to be
having a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I'll go pitch in for McQueen's sake!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna borrow a uniform
from the store manager!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I've got the sunglasses and wig for my disguise ready...
Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, valued customer.
Today, we are handing out coupons to everyone visiting the Fruit Festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Here is your 'Sporting Goods Store Discount Coupon.'
Please, feel free to use it together."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever are you doing, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"I-I've been found out!?
How, even with this wig on!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even I would notice that!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I have spotted Ines and Trainer
peeking in on us from over there.

text_block_list.name: Ryan & Ines
text_block_list.text: Run for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Geez!
Following me around on your own like that...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, having such a lively family
is really nice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps there was no need to worry in the first place,
as Ikuno Dictus could be seen
catching a glimpse of fun.
